name: Sean Duffy

lean.basis: Republican congressman from Wisconsin (2011–2019), Fox Business host, and Trump's transportation secretary.

sources.title: Space.com: Trump names Sean Duffy interim NASA administrator

current_role: U.S. Secretary of Transportation (since January 2025); acting NASA administrator July–December 2025
summary: Sean Duffy, a former reality-TV personality and district attorney, represented Wisconsin in Congress as a Republican from 2011 to 2019 and later hosted on Fox Business. Confirmed as transportation secretary 77–22 in January 2025, he was also named acting NASA administrator in July 2025, which led to a public feud with Elon Musk over SpaceX's moon contract.
